sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness pressures BHP.AX and FMG.AX, but gold juniors (Forrestania, Kaiser, Larvotto, Aureka) deliver strong exploration results; uranium (Infini) also active
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners face margin compression on iron ore; gold and uranium juniors attract speculative flows. Diversification within materials is key

sectors.trend: Positive: oil above $100 on Middle East conflict; tanker wars not expected to suppress supply; domestic energy zone disputes (graziers vs transmission) add policy risk
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) and oil services benefit from elevated crude; renewable policy friction may delay some projects

sectors.trend: Negative: accelerating housing price falls and RBA inaction threaten property valuations; mortgage stress driving consumer distress; Spirit of Tasmania debt to 2052 signals transport sector fragility
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPL risk; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure; RBA unlikely to cut, keeping rates elevated

sectors.trend: Negative: BYD confirms EV tipping point in Australia; car supply crunch jacks up insurance premiums; consumers working second jobs as mortgage costs bite
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from EV transition; insurance (IAG.AX, CGF.AX) premiums rising; consumer discretionary under stress

sectors.trend: Qantas engine incident raises safety scrutiny; Stokes family retakes Seven Network control; volcanic ash disrupts Indonesian aviation links
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational and reputational risk; SVA.AX governance shift; travel demand disrupted short-term

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure; rotate into gold/uranium juniors and energy names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating housing price falls with RBA inaction; rising NPLs for banks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs and property-linked financials; favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WPG.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East escalation and oil above $100 driving inflationary pressure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy exposure (WDS.AX, STO.AX); monitor AUD/USD for inflation import effects

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Qantas operational incident and broader aviation disruption (volcanic ash)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor QAN.AX safety disclosures; short-term travel demand volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino 'Godzilla' event threatening agricultural and energy supply chains
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor SUG.AX, WBC.AX agri exposure; energy demand spikes in winter

risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour essential consumer staples over discretionary; monitor retail sales data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy sector on sustained oil above $100
opportunities.rationale: Middle East conflict and tanker wars unlikely to suppress supply; WDS.AX and STO.AX benefit from elevated crude

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to gold/uranium juniors on strong exploration pipeline

opportunities.recommendation: Position for EV transition beneficiaries in automotive/insurance
opportunities.rationale: BYD confirms Australia EV tipping point; insurance premiums rising on supply crunch; IAG.AX, CGF.AX benefit from premium inflation

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure; rotate to diversified miners
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore crumbling pressures BHP.AX and FMG.AX; BHP exploring strategic options
Housing falls accelerating, RBA won't intervene; NPL risk rising for CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/defensive staples allocation amid consumer stress
defensive_moves.rationale: Second-job uptake and affordability crisis signal demand destruction risk in discretionary

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with sector rotation: energy and gold juniors outperform, iron ore majors and REITs lag. Oil above $100 supports energy but inflationary risk constrains RBA easing. Qantas incident and housing data add volatility. Expect ^AXJO to test recent highs on junior mining momentum.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from housing correction, EV transition, and iron ore demand softening cap large-cap upside. Gold/uranium pipeline and energy security theme offer medium-term opportunities. Consumer stress may persist 6-12 months. RBA likely to hold rates, keeping cost-of-living pressure on discretionary sectors.
